summary: Holds the synthetic official-style parcel records, checks search input, compares identity with a parcel and saves a chosen record to a case.
purpose: Lets a case link to a matching official-style record for the demo, clearly marked as synthetic and not authoritative.
why: Likely reason: keeps the demo realistic without calling a live government system, and the notice text repeats that limit.
how: A notice string states the records are synthetic. A short list of fixture records holds one hero, one control and two ambiguous records. A normalize helper trims and lowercases text. The validateOfficialSearch function checks the search fields and their length. The identityMatch function compares district, circle and village, then the khata and khesra numbers, and returns exact, partial or mismatch. The SyntheticOfficialParcelRecordProvider class finds fixtures matching a query. The OfficialRecordService class wraps search and import, and import looks up the case before saving the chosen record.
inputs: Search fields for district, circle, mauza, khata and khesra, and for import a case identifier and an official record identifier.
outputs: Search results labelled as synthetic demo, an identity match value, or an import result.
risks: Only synthetic data is used. If a real source is connected, the notice and labels must change too. Import writes to the database.
debug: If a search returns nothing, compare the normalized search fields with the fixture list. If import fails, check the case exists, since import looks it up first. The body of the import method is cut off in the packet.
